post.summary: Check in at a bay by scanning its QR code
post.description: The QR code at each bay opens APP_URL/check-in/<code>; the app posts that code here. Finds your confirmed booking at that bay that is running now or starts within 15 minutes, marks it checked in, and returns the hire link if a robot was hired. Checking in again is harmless and keeps the first time.
